title: Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix Clogs Safely: Myth vs Fact
description: Many property owners turn to liquid chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for sluggish drains. However, harsh chemical cleaners often fail to completely clear organic clogs and can cause severe thermal and chemical damage to plastic and aging metal pipes. The exothermic reaction generated by liquid chemicals can deform PVC piping or weaken pipe joints over time. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical drain cleaning methods like drain snakes or hydro-jetting, which clear grease, roots, and debris completely without compromising the structural integrity of the drainage piping system or endangering technicians during future repairs.

Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix Clogs Safely: Myth vs Fact

Many property owners turn to liquid chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for sluggish drains. However, harsh chemical cleaners often fail to completely clear organic clogs and can cause severe thermal and chemical damage to plastic and aging metal pipes. The exothermic reaction generated by liquid chemicals can deform PVC piping or weaken pipe joints over time. Professional plumbers rely on mechanical drain cleaning methods like drain snakes or hydro-jetting, which clear grease, roots, and debris completely without compromising the structural integrity of the drainage piping system or endangering technicians during future repairs.
